'''fleab jedi council deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[fleab]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber|Cor-L-coruscantjedicouncilchamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Coruscant Jedi Council Chamber flea.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

starts as coruscant but is mainly tatooine. It works very well especially if you love to win by force drain.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

you start with the jedi council and heading for the medical frigate. with the heading for the medical frigate you can get to effects that deploy for free on the table and are imunne to alter so you get your squadron assighnments and the camp. Then with your jedi council you can get yoda from reserve deck and since he only costs 4 force to deploy go ahead and get him if he isn't in your hand. Then you can go two ways on how you want to win the game thrue space or thrue land your hand will probebly do the deciding for you. I win a lot with this deck i think it works pretty good as a deck there your doing just for fun kind of thing. I havent a clue how it would do in a turnament because i have yet to go to one. The ships dont have to be what they are you can change them I justy found those to work best for me. And for all the starfighters you must have there matching pilots for it to work.

Note(apology about not giveing further information and the han and chewbacca you where quite right. terribly sorry for that mix up.
